title: Finite comparison transport of compact-product arrows
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative coefficient ring of the small-site size. Use the compact-product arrows [def-pur-compact-product-arrows], proper-support maps [def-pur-proper-support-compact-maps], retained witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and the canonical comparisons [lem-pur-support-site-comparison, lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison]. Define pro-etale compact sections on a specified compactification as derived global sections of its exact extension by zero. Define their finite etale-to-pro-etale comparison by the finite global comparison on the zero extension followed by the derived ordinary open-comparison mate; this is an isomorphism. Insert each retained witness isomorphism to obtain its compact and supported comparison maps. Use precisely the support comparison's canonical pullback-tensor isomorphism and the two witness isomorphisms to identify the compared exterior product with the actual pro-etale exterior product. Define the pro-etale compact exterior-product arrow by transport of the etale compact exterior arrow through these specified comparisons, retaining a specified bounded-below representative of the output. For a proper support, whenever its canonical supported comparison is invertible, define the pro-etale proper-support map by its inverse, followed by the etale $u_Z$ and the compact comparison. The canonical witness for the exact comparison image is given by the inverse bounded-below inclusion compatibility, and the output comparison uses this same compatibility. The site comparison uses [lem-pur-support-site-comparison] and [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison].

lean.statement: def compactProductProMap [Finite A] {B X Y : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ B} {g : Y ⟶ B} (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification g) (K : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (wK : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness X A K) (wL : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness Y A L) (F : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf (pullback f g).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (eF : F.obj ≅ externalProduct (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g wK.complex.obj wL.complex.obj) : (compactProductProSections A c).obj K.obj ⊗ (compactProductProSections A d).obj L.obj ⟶ (compactProductProSections A (compactProductCompactification c d)).obj (ProEtale.externalProduct (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f g K.obj L.obj)
